summary: Independent review found a P2 documentation-checker weakness: maintained docs only require an incidental 0.1.29 token, not that their actual declared desired version matches the authoritative descriptor.
blockers: Parse each maintained document's actual desired chart version declaration and compare it to .codicarium/dev/deploy.yaml; add a stale-declaration regression fixture.
next_action: Remediate the checker, rerun docs/full CI, and obtain a fresh exact-head review.

findings.summary: Incidental version token can mask stale declaration.
